LanguageData.Gun_AKS-74U_RWP.description: A compact and lightweight carbine derived from the AK-74, the AKS-74U offers a balanced mix of firepower and maneuverability. Ideal for close-quarters combat, it sacrifices some precision and range for a higher rate of fire, making it a formidable weapon for quick, decisive engagements.
